metadata.title: How to preserve folklore and songs of Hills| लोक कथा और गीतों को कैसे बचाएँ
metadata.description: Folk tales contain the history of the  lifestyle, culture of communities and also the changes that have taken place in that area. That is why the protection of folk songs and folk arts is very important. Recently we have visited the Giri Par area of ​​Himachal Pradesh. Here we also got a chance to see the subtleties of music along with Sirmauri songs, dance and instruments.
